changes: Removed p3 'Saśeraṃtumāla' as scribe: 'vārāṇasīsaśeraṃtumāla' reads more like a place description (vārāṇasī + śahara/śahera 'city', possibly a mohalla name) than a personal name. No scribe is securely named; the uncertainty is now explained in notes.
Bhaṭṭoji: as_written kept, with a note that 'bhaṭṭaji' is a corrupt spelling of Bhaṭṭoji. Added a note that Lakṣmīdhara is the author's father, named only as the author's relative.

Date: tithi changed to '3 (tṛtīyā?)'. 'jātiyā' is probably a corrupt spelling of tṛtīyā, and the numeral 3 at the end supports this. Weekday normalized to Sunday (ādityavāra). Pakṣa normalized to kṛṣṇa (vadī).
Place: as_written changed to the full string.

date.as_written: saṃvat 1695 samae āṣāḍha vadī jātiyā vāra ādit vā 3

notes: 'likhitaṃ vārāṇasīsaśeraṃtumāla' is corrupt. It probably contains 'vārāṇasī śahara/śahera' ('the city of Vārāṇasī') plus a locality name (…tumāla?). It could also hide the scribe's name, but no personal name can be read with any confidence, so no scribe is recorded. 'bhaṭṭaji' is a corrupt spelling of Bhaṭṭoji. 'mauḥ manoramāyāṅ' is a corrupt spelling of prauḍhamanoramāyāṃ (the chapter is the kṛdanta section). The tithi 'jātiyā' plus the closing '3' suggests tṛtīyā. The year matches the catalogue (VS 1695 = c. 1638 CE). In the north-Indian pūrṇimānta reckoning, Āṣāḍha kṛṣṇa 3 would fall around June 1638.
